origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored property files and a no-network Debug Sampler plan for deterministic configuration-source, Java-properties parsing, CLI precedence, and explicit environment projections.

license.repository_notice: LICENSE and NOTICE at repository root
license.upstream_distribution_use: Apache JMeter is a pinned external oracle only; no upstream plan, result, binary, or source file is redistributed.

locale_materialization.portable_contract: materialize en-US as an installed target-OS locale with an explicit UTF-8 codeset; POSIX may use en_US.UTF-8 and Windows may use en-US
locale_materialization.unavailable_behavior: fail fixture setup or evidence promotion; never silently use C/POSIX or an uninstalled alias

jvm_encoding_observation.missing_behavior: fail evidence promotion; requested UTF-8 is not an observation

property_file_decoder.status: static-input-contract; effective literal UTF-8 probe remains oracle-pending

runtime.hostname_policy: not asserted; no hostname is in the static expectation
runtime.jmeter_classpath: not executed; future runs must use only the pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distribution

runner_gaps.effect: the current parser rejects -p and a second -q occurrence, while its narrow option validator also rejects this fixture's intentional -S/-D/-G vectors; do not remove, rewrite, or weaken those vectors to make validation pass
the current materializer uses an isolated generated output directory and does not consume command.working_directory; a future runner must chdir to <case-root> before resolving fixture-relative inputs
the custom projection maps and remote-only absence assertions are static contract data, not currently executed comparison input

harness_gaps: No Java vendor/version, target triple, OS image, effective locale, or effective default charset has been recorded because no oracle process was run; the corresponding runtime fields are null.

The profile requires an empty inherited-environment allowlist; a future harness must resolve <jmeter-home> and Java explicitly without ambient PATH and record the requested versus observed locale/charset values.
The case root must be resolved and used as the process working directory before any relative input or output path; this static corpus cannot verify a runner's chdir.

Implicit user.properties and system.properties paths must be read from the initial -p file and resolved from the case working directory, then <jmeter-home>/bin as the declared fallback; ambient files are not valid evidence.
Linux/Windows/macOS path-separator, launcher, locale, filesystem, and process behavior remain untested.
-G remote properties require a remote worker run before they can be observed; this corpus stores only a static merge projection.
